proposed.text: A funeral home embalming room requires mechanical coordination. Which source-safe design approach should be carried into the proposed answer?

options.text: Share the chapel HVAC as a cost-saving default without checking odor, chemical, or health requirements
Provide a separately reviewed exhaust/ventilation strategy and confirm health, sanitation, and mechanical requirements before final sizing
Rely only on natural ventilation because PD 1096 lists a window-opening rule for ordinary rooms
Use one standard commercial HVAC system for all rooms regardless of service function

proposed.rationale: The local source packet supports building-code classification and egress, but not a universal numeric HVAC prescription for embalming rooms. The source-safe answer is to require a separately reviewed mechanical strategy and confirm the applicable health/mechanical requirements.
proposed.explanation: Use a separate, purpose-reviewed ventilation/exhaust strategy for embalming service areas. Do not present an unsupported negative-pressure number or configuration as a locally sourced code rule.
